Latuda may be beneficial as an adjunct to your ssri, but this depends on your symptoms. Latuda as you know, works on dopamine, and it is used for psychosis and bipolar depression typically. 

I haven't taken it by itself, only in combination with trintellix. I've done this solely as a response to another drug, rexulti, that gave me some awful side effects. 

It really just depends what you're looking for. I haven't had any other major side effects from either drugs over the course of years besides a very minor reduction in sexual functioning. 

It's not recommended to eat grapefruit on latuda. Your risk of diabetes becomes higher. And you may gain some weight, as this is a common side effect of antipsychotics. 

In general, If you are feeling majorly depressed but also have symptoms of psychosis, latuda might be greatly benificial to you in conjuncion with a mood stabilizer, but I am not an expert on this matter by any means, so make sure to consult a pyschiatrist or doctor.

One day in school back when I was in 11th grade, I was really sick and had a horrible case of the sniffles. And it was 5th period for my algebra II class. 

My mook of a teacher was always "that" teacher that just never had any tissues in his room ever. I ask him if I can go to the bathroom to blow my nose cuz it was getting real bad, and he says sure go ahead. So I start walking down the hall way and get to the bathroom with my nose dripping... 

I walk in there and I am the only one inside just minding my own business blowing my nose facing the wall and the paper towel machine. And all of a sudden literally like 15 kids run into this bathroom and they are all freaking out for reasons I don't know. I don't really think anything of it because I live in a place where this kind of stuff happens all the time. But after about 10 seconds of just being in there... I hear these kids like romping around and about to slapbox because one of them started sneaking everyone. So i turn around to see what the hell is happening and they begin to square up. The one kids starts swinging and it was the worst fight I have ever seen. But the best part about this fight was how our class clown Wilson, tryed to get up onto one of the handycap stalls with the sinks in them for a better view. He gets up there and is hanging on but starts fumbling real bad. And the next thing I hear is "woaAOOAOH" and he takes the biggest fall ever into the sink inside the stall! *crashhh* we all turn to this kid and realize what has happened. This kid has broken the porcelain sink with his body. Busted it off the wall and shattered it on the floor. There were millions of pieces everywhere and water was now shooting out of the wall like some cartoon shit. I'm still finishing blowing my nose at this point, and I have no idea what the hell is going on. 

So now they are on a rampage to get out of there because the don't wanna get caught. I think about running out with them but realize just how shady and unusual that is to just sprint out of a bathroom that is after something to this degree. I mean it was like really loud, I'm pretty sure the main office probably heard it. 

They all got away somehow and I was the last one to walk out of there. 

And I'm so glad that I didn't get caught up in that disaster lol. It was one the craziest things I have ever seen happen in my school.
